description: Add the fixed E18 DocumentCache, projection-work, lifecycle-state, source-identity, and cache UUID-validation inventory to both provider emitters without adding fixed objects to DerivedRelationalModelSet.
acceptance-criteria: PostgreSQL and SQL Server emit the design-owned DataStoreIdentity, DocumentCache, DocumentProjectionWork, and DocumentCacheState tables with provider-equivalent columns, types, keys, constraints, defaults, and deterministic dependency order.

DocumentCache uses StreamEtag, a provider JSON-object constraint, a DocumentId primary key and cascading parent foreign key, and a non-indexed denormalized DocumentUuid; legacy Etag, UX_DocumentCache_DocumentUuid, DocumentUuid indexes, and IX_DocumentCache_ProjectName_ResourceName_LastModifiedAt are absent.

DocumentProjectionWork has the four design-owned columns, a cascading DocumentId parent relationship, and IX_DocumentProjectionWork_FirstEnqueuedAt_DocumentId as its only ordinary projector-discovery index; no source ContentVersion discovery index or worker-claim fields are added.

DocumentCacheState enforces the singleton and four exact lifecycle tokens, including binary collation and byte-length enforcement for SQL Server, and initializes only an absent singleton as Disabled with a clear latch.
DataStoreIdentity initializes only an absent singleton with a provider-generated nonzero UUID and never replaces an existing SourceIdentity.

Both providers emit TR_DocumentCache_ValidateDocumentUuid; PostgreSQL also emits SECURITY INVOKER TF_DocumentCache_ValidateDocumentUuid. Matching cache UUIDs are accepted and mismatches are rejected without parsing DocumentJson.
Fixed names and shapes remain in CoreDdlEmitter or focused shared core definitions, DerivedRelationalModelSet remains resource-derived, and RelationalMappingVersion remains v2.
steps-to-verify: Run `dotnet csharpier format src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit`.

Run `dotnet test src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~CoreDdlEmitter|FullyQualifiedName~SeedDmlEmitter"`.
Inspect focused provider assertions for the complete fixed inventory and the absence of every named legacy artifact.

description: Emit the PostgreSQL transactional projection-enqueue functions, statement triggers, ownership, provisioning membership, and least-privilege database-local grants.
acceptance-criteria: Generated SQL creates or safely reuses the locked-down NOLOGIN edfi_dms_enqueue_owner and gives SESSION_USER only direct SET TRUE, INHERIT FALSE, ADMIN FALSE membership needed for provisioning.

TF_Document_EnqueueProjectionInsert and TF_Document_EnqueueProjectionUpdate are SECURITY DEFINER, owned by edfi_dms_enqueue_owner, use a pg_catalog-only search_path, schema-qualify DMS references, and expose no PUBLIC execute or direct work-table mutation rights.

The enqueue owner receives only dms schema usage, DocumentCacheState read, and DocumentProjectionWork read/insert/update privileges; generated DDL grants no runtime DMS or CDC membership and emits no CDC capture object.

Separate AFTER INSERT and AFTER UPDATE statement triggers use the required transition relations, read StateId 1 once, reject a missing or invalid lifecycle row, enqueue only in Resetting, Rebuilding, or Tracking, and filter unchanged ContentVersion updates.

One statement_timestamp() value is shared by all new or advanced requirements in a statement; requirements coalesce monotonically, FirstEnqueuedAt remains stable, and non-advancing requirements receive no work-row or timestamp DML.
Role, function, ownership, grant, and trigger emission is deterministic and follows bounded phase-zero prerequisites and referenced-object creation.
steps-to-verify: Run `dotnet csharpier format src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit`.

Run `dotnet test src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Pgsql&FullyQualifiedName~Enqueue"`.
Inspect focused SQL assertions for role attributes, membership options, function security/search path, grants, transition relations, lifecycle gating, and timestamp-preserving upsert predicates.

description: Emit the SQL Server set-based transactional projection-enqueue trigger through the existing dms ownership chain and remove server-configuration reads from generated stamp triggers.
acceptance-criteria: TR_Document_EnqueueProjectionWork is one AFTER INSERT, UPDATE trigger over inserted and deleted with static schema-qualified references, no EXECUTE AS clause, and no enqueue user or role.
Every inserted row and only updated rows whose ContentVersion changed are eligible; the trigger reads StateId 1 once and rejects a missing or invalid lifecycle row.
Resetting, Rebuilding, and Tracking coalesce the greatest required version while Disabled records no work.

One SYSUTCDATETIME() datetime2(7) value is shared by all new or advanced requirements in a statement; FirstEnqueuedAt remains stable and non-advancing requirements receive no work-row or timestamp DML.
Generated resource and descriptor *_Stamp triggers do not query sys.configurations or validate the server-level nested-trigger setting.
Generated DDL emits no production enqueue identity, runtime grant matrix, CDC capture object, or CDC work-table access.
steps-to-verify: Run `dotnet csharpier format src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit`.

Run `dotnet test src/dms/backend/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit/EdFi.DataManagementService.Backend.Ddl.Tests.Unit.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~Mssql&FullyQualifiedName~Enqueue"`.

Both providers reject legacy DocumentCache.Etag, UX_DocumentCache_DocumentUuid, and IX_DocumentCache_ProjectName_ResourceName_LastModifiedAt before mutation with drop-and-recreate guidance.
